question.q: The northern lights, also known as _______, are a spectacular natural phenomenon in the polar skies.
question.justification: الشفق القطبي (aurora) هو عرض ضوئي طبيعي في السماء قرب القطبين. تسونامي (tsunami) موجات مد، والبركان (volcano) جبل ناري، والزلزال (earthquake) اهتزاز أرضي.
question.context_sentence: The northern lights, also known as _______, are a spectacular natural phenomenon in the polar skies.

question.q: We could hear the _______ of burning wood in the fireplace.
question.justification: سُمعت أصوات طقطقة (crackling) خفيفة قرب الشفق. الصامت (silent) عكس ذلك، والموسيقي (musical) والمرتفع (loud) ليست أوصافاً دقيقة.
question.context_sentence: We could hear the _______ of burning wood in the fireplace.

question.q: The _______ sound of the steak on the grill made everyone hungry.
question.justification: البعض وصف صوت الشفق بأنه أزيز (sizzling) مثل أزيز الطعام في المقلاة. التجمد (freezing) واللمعان (shining) والطفو (floating) ليست أصواتاً.
question.context_sentence: The _______ sound of the steak on the grill made everyone hungry.

question.q: Scientists monitor _______ storms that can disrupt satellite communications.
question.justification: العاصفة المغناطيسية الأرضية (geomagnetic) تولد الأضواء والأصوات. الشمسية (solar) واسعة، والزلزالية (seismic) للأرض، والجوية (atmospheric) عامة.
question.context_sentence: Scientists monitor _______ storms that can disrupt satellite communications.

question.q: Certain medications can _______ drowsiness as a side effect.
question.justification: العاصفة تولد (induce) شحنات كهربائية صغيرة. المنع (blocks) والإزالة (removes) والتجاهل (ignores) عكس ذلك.
question.context_sentence: Certain medications can _______ drowsiness as a side effect.

question.q: The phone started to _______ when someone called, but there was no ringtone.
question.justification: الإبر الصنوبرية تهتز (vibrate) وتصدر أصواتاً خافتة. الذوبان (melt) والنمو (grow) والاختفاء (disappear) لا ينتج عنها أصوات.
question.context_sentence: The phone started to _______ when someone called, but there was no ringtone.

question.q: The rare butterfly is so _______ that few photographers have captured it on camera.
question.justification: الصوت الشفقي بعيد المنال (elusive) ويصعب تسجيله. الواضح (obvious) والمرتفع (loud) والدائم (permanent) عكس ذلك.
question.context_sentence: The rare butterfly is so _______ that few photographers have captured it on camera.

question.q: According to _______, a ghost haunts the old castle on the hill.
question.justification: الفولكلور (folklore) السامي يتضمن قصصاً عن أصوات الشفق. العلم (science) والتكنولوجيا (technology) والصناعة (industry) مجالات حديثة.
question.context_sentence: According to _______, a ghost haunts the old castle on the hill.

question.q: The newborn explored the world through _______ experiences like touch and taste.
question.justification: تجربة الشفق حسية (sensory) كاملة. البصرية (visual) والسمعية (auditory) واللمسية (tactile) أجزاء منها.
question.context_sentence: The newborn explored the world through _______ experiences like touch and taste.

question.q: Astronomers study _______ bodies such as stars, planets, and comets.
question.justification: السياح يأملون مشاهدة العرض السماوي (celestial). الأرضي (underground) والمحيطي (oceanic) والحضري (urban) ليست مشاهد سماوية.
question.context_sentence: Astronomers study _______ bodies such as stars, planets, and comets.

question.q: The statue of the ancient king stood like a _______ over the valley.
question.justification: الفاو يسمى عملاق الصحراء (colossus). القرية (village) صغيرة، والواحة (oasis) خضراء، والسراب (mirage) وهم.
question.context_sentence: The statue of the ancient king stood like a _______ over the valley.

question.q: The ancient temple was filled with the sweet aroma of burning _______.
question.justification: الفاو كانت محطة على طريق تجارة اللبان (frankincense). الحرير (silk) والتوابل (spice) والذهب (gold) طرق أخرى.
question.context_sentence: The ancient temple was filled with the sweet aroma of burning _______.

question.q: A long _______ of camels crossed the desert, carrying spices and silks.
question.justification: قوافل (caravans) الجمال كانت تنقل البضائع. الأساطيل (fleets) للسفن، والجيوش (armies) للجنود، والقطعان (herds) للحيوانات.
question.context_sentence: A long _______ of camels crossed the desert, carrying spices and silks.

question.q: New York City is known for its _______ atmosphere, where people from all over the world live together.
question.justification: الفاو كان مركزاً عالمياً (cosmopolitan) متنوع الثقافات. المعزول (isolated) والبدائي (primitive) والفارغ (empty) عكس ذلك.
question.context_sentence: New York City is known for its _______ atmosphere, where people from all over the world live together.

question.q: The canals provided _______ to the fields, ensuring the crops grew tall and healthy.
question.justification: الفاو تمتلك نظام ري (irrigation) معقد. النقل (transportation) والتعليم (education) والدفاع (defense) أنظمة أخرى.
question.context_sentence: The canals provided _______ to the fields, ensuring the crops grew tall and healthy.

question.q: The stone tablet had an ancient _______ carved into its surface.
question.justification: القبور زُينت بنقوش (inscriptions). اللوحات (paintings) والسجاد (tapestries) والتماثيل (statues) ليست ما ذكر في النص.
question.context_sentence: The stone tablet had an ancient _______ carved into its surface.

question.q: The empire began to _______ after a hundred years of prosperity.
question.justification: تراجعت الفاو بعد انحدار (decline) تجارة البخور. الصعود (rise) والذروة (peak) والازدهار (boom) عكس ذلك.
question.context_sentence: The empire began to _______ after a hundred years of prosperity.

question.q: The pyramids of Giza are a _______ World Heritage Site.
question.justification: اليونسكو (UNESCO) هي منظمة التراث العالمي. ناسا (NASA) للفضاء، والناتو (NATO) عسكري، وأوبك (OPEC) للنفط.
question.context_sentence: The pyramids of Giza are a _______ World Heritage Site.

question.q: The _______ tunnels beneath the city were used as shelters during the war.
question.justification: مونتريال لديها شبكة أنفاق تحت الأرض (subterranean). الجوي (aerial) والسطح (surface) والساحلي (coastal) ليست تحت الأرض.
question.context_sentence: The _______ tunnels beneath the city were used as shelters during the war.

question.q: Getting lost in the _______ of narrow streets was part of the adventure in the old medina.
question.justification: المدينة تحت الأرض تشبه المتاهة (labyrinth). الطريق السريع (highway) والجسر (bridge) والبرج (tower) لا تصفها.
question.context_sentence: Getting lost in the _______ of narrow streets was part of the adventure in the old medina.

question.q: We need to find a _______ source of energy that won't run out.
question.justification: 'sustainable' تعني قادر على الاستمرار دون استنزاف الموارد. 'temporary' مؤقت، 'weak' ضعيف، 'limited' محدود.
question.context_sentence: We need to find a _______ source of energy that won't run out.

question.q: The company encourages _______ by rewarding employees for creative ideas.
question.justification: 'innovation' تعني ابتكار أو تجديد. 'destruction' تدمير، 'tradition' تقليد، 'imitation' تقليد (نسخ).
question.context_sentence: The company encourages _______ by rewarding employees for creative ideas.

question.q: Coral reefs are a delicate _______ that can be easily damaged by pollution.
question.justification: 'ecosystem' يشير إلى مجتمع الكائنات الحية وبيئتها. 'machine' آلة، 'building' مبنى، 'vehicle' مركبة.
question.context_sentence: Coral reefs are a delicate _______ that can be easily damaged by pollution.

question.q: The sudden increase in temperature was a natural _______ that scientists studied.
question.justification: 'phenomenon' تعني ظاهرة طبيعية أو اجتماعية ملفتة. 'problem' مشكلة، 'solution' حل، 'theory' نظرية.
question.context_sentence: The sudden increase in temperature was a natural _______ that scientists studied.

question.q: Early sailors used the stars for _______ across the open ocean.
question.justification: 'navigation' تعني فن توجيه المركبات أو السفن. 'cooking' طبخ، 'gardening' زراعة، 'painting' رسم.
question.context_sentence: Early sailors used the stars for _______ across the open ocean.

question.q: The ancient mosque is part of the cultural _______ of the region.
question.justification: 'heritage' تعني إرث ثقافي أو تاريخي. 'problem' مشكلة، 'expense' مصروف، 'noise' ضوضاء.
question.context_sentence: The ancient mosque is part of the cultural _______ of the region.

question.q: Wind and solar power are _______ energy sources.
question.justification: 'renewable' تعني قابل للتجديد مثل الطاقة الشمسية. 'finite' محدود، 'dangerous' خطر، 'expensive' غالي.
question.context_sentence: Wind and solar power are _______ energy sources.

question.q: The city is spending billions on improving its _______ including roads and bridges.
question.justification: 'infrastructure' تشير إلى المرافق الأساسية كالطرق والجسور. 'entertainment' ترفيه، 'fashion' موضة، 'cuisine' مطبخ.
question.context_sentence: The city is spending billions on improving its _______ including roads and bridges.

question.q: The _______ orbits the Earth and sends back weather data.
question.justification: 'satellite' هو جسم يدور حول كوكب، وغالباً يستخدم للاتصالات. 'submarine' غواصة، 'airplane' طائرة، 'train' قطار.
question.context_sentence: The _______ orbits the Earth and sends back weather data.

question.q: The severe _______ caused the crops to wither and die.
question.justification: 'drought' تعني فترة طويلة من الجفاف. 'flood' فيضان، 'earthquake' زلزال، 'volcano' بركان.
question.context_sentence: The severe _______ caused the crops to wither and die.

question.q: Childhood _______ is a growing concern due to poor diet and lack of exercise.
question.justification: 'obesity' حالة زيادة الوزن المفرطة. 'thinness' نحافة، 'tallness' طول، 'weakness' ضعف.
question.context_sentence: Childhood _______ is a growing concern due to poor diet and lack of exercise.

question.q: Eating healthy food can boost your _______ system.
question.justification: 'immune' يتعلق بجهاز المناعة. 'digestive' هضمي، 'nervous' عصبي، 'skeletal' هيكلي.
question.context_sentence: Eating healthy food can boost your _______ system.

question.q: Puzzles and memory games can help maintain _______ function in old age.
question.justification: 'cognitive' تعني متعلق بالعمليات العقلية كالتفكير. 'physical' جسدي، 'emotional' عاطفي، 'social' اجتماعي.
question.context_sentence: Puzzles and memory games can help maintain _______ function in old age.

question.q: Sleep _______ can lead to serious health problems.
question.justification: 'deprivation' تعني الحرمان من شيء ضروري. 'excess' إفراط، 'addition' إضافة، 'balance' توازن.
question.context_sentence: Sleep _______ can lead to serious health problems.

question.q: The _______ of the two companies created a new industry leader.
question.justification: 'consolidation' تعني دمج أو تقوية شيء مثل الذاكرة. 'destruction' تدمير، 'separation' فصل، 'weakening' إضعاف.
question.context_sentence: The _______ of the two companies created a new industry leader.

question.q: The ozone layer acts as a _______ against harmful ultraviolet rays.
question.justification: 'shield' كفعل تعني يحمي، وكاسم تعني درع. 'attack' يهاجم، 'expose' يعرض، 'damage' يتلف.
question.context_sentence: The ozone layer acts as a _______ against harmful ultraviolet rays.

question.q: Factories must reduce their carbon _______ to combat climate change.
question.justification: 'emission' تعني انبعاث الغازات. 'absorption' امتصاص، 'reflection' انعكاس، 'collection' جمع.
question.context_sentence: Factories must reduce their carbon _______ to combat climate change.

question.q: The entire neighborhood lost power when the _______ failed.
question.justification: 'grid' تشير إلى شبكة الكهرباء. 'river' نهر، 'forest' غابة، 'mountain' جبل.
question.context_sentence: The entire neighborhood lost power when the _______ failed.

question.q: The stadium has a _______ of 50,000 spectators.
question.justification: 'capacity' تعني قدرة استيعاب أو حجم. 'color' لون، 'shape' شكل، 'speed' سرعة.
question.context_sentence: The stadium has a _______ of 50,000 spectators.

question.q: The castle was _______ located on a hilltop for defense.
question.justification: 'strategically' تعني بطريقة مخططة بعناية. 'randomly' عشوائياً، 'poorly' بشكل سيئ، 'quickly' بسرعة.
question.context_sentence: The castle was _______ located on a hilltop for defense.
